Selected Work

Kinetica

Completed study

Impact takes different forms.

Kinetica samples weapon motion and evaluates each impact in Unity. The result drives localized vertex deformation and material-specific VFX, giving Slime a springy rebound, Stone a burst of debris and Metal a brief spray of sparks.

Explore case study

Confluence

Early blockout / In development

Life along a changing coast.

An ongoing Unreal Engine 5 study of a dense coastal city adapting to a changing climate. A terraced blockout places housing alongside a rail corridor, while modular facade tests explore how its residential buildings fit together.

Development Notes

2026-11-21

Project Confluence — Corner Modules and Adjustable Building Dimensions

Adding instanced corner modules to the four-sided building shell and testing how they respond to changes in facade dimensions and floor count.

2026-11-14

Project Confluence — Assembling a Four-Sided Building Shell

Extending a two-facade corner into a four-sided building shell, testing how different facade layouts affect its footprint, and moving the placement logic into a reusable Blueprint function.

2026-11-07

Project Confluence — Configurable Facades and Building Assembly

Extending the facade Blueprint with per-cell module selection and using reusable facade actors to assemble an adjustable building corner in Unreal Engine 5.

About

I’m a computer science undergraduate exploring technical art and environment art. Whether it’s the spring of a soft surface or the shape of a hillside street, the look I have in mind guides what I build. The breakdown and development notes share the tests and revisions behind the images.
